purpose: Teach: 羽根/遊戯/製図/海面/浴室/祖父母/出稼ぎ/蔵書

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お正月にメイ姉さんと羽根つきしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's play badminton together on New Year's, shall we?
lines.style: Warm and inviting, like extending a hand. Soft opening. The tenderness of someone who knows how to make a child feel seen. Gentle pace, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、遊戯室で遊びたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to play in the game room instead.
lines.style: Direct and clear, with the innocent certainty of childhood. A little eager, testing. Not whining — just stating what he wants. Quick, open delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお家の製図を描いてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is drawing up plans for the house right now.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly distant. Like she's noticed something and sharing it tenderly. Soft, reflective pace. Not lecturing — just noticing aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、海面に夕日が映る景色見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw the sunset reflecting on the ocean the other day.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the voice. A child sharing something he found beautiful. Slight awe underneath. Tender, not performative. Trails off softly at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお家の浴室、新しいわね
lines.en: Sho, my bathroom at home is brand new.
lines.style: A small offer, shared gently. Like she's thinking of things that might delight him. Soft, almost conversational. Slight uplift at the end, inviting his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、祖父母大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandma and Grandpa.
lines.style: Unguarded affection. The simplicity and certainty of a child saying something true without self-consciousness. Warm, direct, genuine. Small voice but clear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは昔、出稼ぎで都会に行かれたんですって
lines.en: Sho, your father went to the city for work a long time ago, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, like sharing something she's learned. A gentle passing-on of understanding. Slow, reflective pace. The warmth of someone trusting a child with a small piece of family history.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの蔵書を見てみたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'd love to look at your book collection sometime.
lines.style: Soft curiosity and affection woven together. A child asking to enter into something that matters to her. Gentle, sincere. Slight hope underneath — will she let me?
